subject: BlueProxy processor reclassification — clarification & evidence request
messages:
From: Ami Rao <ami@blueproxy.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:12:00Z
Subject: Notice: reclassification of telemetry-processor role (BlueProxy)

Hi Neha,

Quick note from BlueProxy engineering/legal — we are changing the role of our telemetry-processor subcomponent from 'processing (PII permitted)' to 'metrics-only (no persistent identifiers)'. The change is part of a migration that will: 
- Stop persisting user identifiers (hashed_ids removed)
- Aggregate at the session level only (30 minute windows)
- Shift storage to our EU-only onshore cluster (Frankfurt region)

Effective date proposed: 2027-06-10.

Attached: bp_subproc_change_notice.pdf (summary + proposed Annex language). We know this triggers a DPA addendum /subprocessor review on your side — opening the thread to confirm what evidence Redwood will need and whether the proposed timeline works.

If helpful, I can loop in our legal ops contact.

Thanks,
Ami Rao
Partner Success — BlueProxy
ami@blueproxy.io

-- attachment: bp_subproc_change_notice.pdf (PDF, 92KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ami Rao <ami@blueproxy.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice: reclassification of telemetry-processor role (BlueProxy)

Ami — thanks for the heads up and the notice. A few quick clarifying questions so we can triage internally: 

1) Dataflow & export paths: does the change alter any egress route (e.g., will any telemetry still transit via non-EU network hops)? Please attach a dataflow diagram and list of egress countries.
2) Identifiers: you say hashed_ids are removed — do any other stable identifiers remain (device_id, KV cache keys, or client-generated tokens)?
3) Evidence: we typically require the latest SOC 2 snapshot, the KMS jurisdiction for any retained keys, and a short explanation of retention windows for aggregated metrics.
4) DPA impact: do you expect to sign the Annex we proposed in the attached checklist or do you prefer to edit the Annex language?

Can you send the dataflow_v2.svg and a SOC2 snapshot? Attaching our requested_evidence_checklist.pdf for reference.

We will loop in Legal (Kimberly) for the DPA review and Engineering (Rishi) to validate routing/egress. For timing: if you need acceptance by 2027-06-10 we’ll aim for a provisional review by 2027-05-27; please confirm availability for a short call this week if helpful.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Privacy Program Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

-- attachment: requested_evidence_checklist.pdf (PDF, 24KB)
From: Ami Rao <ami@blueproxy.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueProxy Legal <legal@blueproxy.io>
Date: 2027-05-24T09:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice: reclassification of telemetry-processor role (BlueProxy)

Neha — thanks, quick answers below and attached artifacts.

On dataflow & egress:
- Storage will be on our eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) cluster. Transit path uses our EU relay network; no third-country hops for persisted metrics. Real-time telemetry may still route via global edges for routing efficiency, but persisted aggregates are stored onshore. See attached dataflow_v2.svg.

On identifiers:
- We are removing hashed_ids and client-specific tokens from persisted payloads. Device_id will be present only for session-scoped rolls and is truncated to 8-char random salt (non-reversible). No KV cache keys or raw client tokens will be persisted.

On evidence:
- Attached: blueproxy_soc2_snapshot.pdf (latest snapshot, control map included).
- KMS: keys are managed under BlueProxy KMS in eu-west-1 (AWS-managed keys) — we use envelope encryption and rotate monthly.

On DPA & Annex:
- We can sign the Annex with the redlines you proposed; legal has prepared a DocuSign packet for the Annex (link below). If Redwood requires additional contractual language around onshore fallback, we can accept provisional acceptance and a 30-day remediation window.

Proposed timeline: production cutover to metrics-only on 2027-06-10; we are available for a 30-minute call on 2027-05-25 between 09:00-11:00 UTC.

DocuSign (Annex): https://docusign.com/blueproxy/annex/XXXXXXXX

Regards,
Ami Rao
Partner Success — BlueProxy

-- attachments: dataflow_v2.svg (SVG), blueproxy_soc2_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 1.4MB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ami Rao <ami@blueproxy.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice: reclassification of telemetry-processor role (BlueProxy)

Ami — appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachments. Summary & next steps from our side: 

Summary:
- BlueProxy will change persisted telemetry to metrics-only and move storage to EU onshore cluster; hashed_ids removed; truncated device identifiers retained for session aggregation only. SOC2 snapshot and dataflow provided.

Action items (Redwood):
- Legal (Kimberly): review DocuSign Annex and confirm whether redlines are acceptable. Target: 2027-05-27 EOD.
- Engineering (Rishi): validate dataflow_v2.svg for any hidden egress paths and confirm KV/cache flows do not persist PII. Target: 2027-05-26 COB.
- Security (me): validate SOC2 control mapping vs our checklist and confirm whether onshore fallback test is required before 2027-06-10. Target: 2027-05-27.

Conditional acceptance: Redwood can provisionally accept the change on 2027-06-10 provided legal signs the Annex and Engineering clears the routing/egress items. If engineering finds non-EU egress for persisted data, we will require an interim onshore-fallback runbook and a roll-back window.

Kimberly — can you confirm whether Legal needs any additional info from BlueProxy legal (we have the DocuSign link Ami provided)?
Rishi — can you pick this up and ping if you want the team to join the 05-25 slot Ami suggested?

Thanks — will reconvene after your checks.

-Neha
Security & Privacy Program Manager, Redwood Inference
